segments.zh: 这是轻读，为 lightnovel.fun 打造的沉浸式阅读脚本。在书籍页面点一下「沉浸阅读」，就能进入干净无干扰的阅读界面。
segments.en: This is LightNovel Immersive Reader, a userscript for lightnovel dot fun. On any book page, one click opens a clean, distraction-free reader.

segments.calloutZh: ♾️ 网文无缝连续滚动（v2.0 新增）
segments.calloutEn: Seamless continuous scroll — new in v2.0
segments.zh: 二点零版本新增网文无缝滚动：读到章节末尾继续往下滚，下一章自动接上，章节之间有清晰的分隔带。章节都会提前在后台加载好，完全不用等待。
segments.en: New in version two: seamless scrolling. Keep scrolling past a chapter's end and the next chapter flows right in, marked by a clear divider. Chapters are prefetched in the background, so there is never a wait.

segments.calloutZh: 🧭 进度胶囊 + 左侧大纲
segments.zh: 左下角的胶囊实时显示当前章节和全书进度；左侧大纲随阅读自动跟随，点击任意章节即可跳转。
segments.en: The chip at the bottom left tracks your chapter and overall progress. The outline follows along as you read — click any chapter to jump.

segments.calloutZh: 🗺️ Sublime 式缩略图与 ↑/↓ 角标
segments.zh: 右侧是 Sublime 风格的缩略图，精细呈现当前章节窗口；顶部和底部的角标告诉你窗口之外还有多少章，点哪里就跳到哪里。
segments.en: On the right, a Sublime-style minimap shows the loaded chapters in detail. The caps at its edges count the chapters beyond the window — click anywhere to jump.

segments.zh: 切到书签标签，点击任意段落就能添加书签；书签按章节归档，缩略图上也有琥珀色的标记。
segments.en: Switch to the bookmarks tab and click any paragraph to bookmark it — organized per chapter, with amber ticks on the minimap.

segments.zh: 设置里可以换主题、调字号、行距和页宽，开关连续滚动与续读；进度按账号保存，还能导出导入。
segments.en: In settings: themes, font size, line height and page width — plus toggles for seamless scrolling and resume. Progress is saved per account and can be exported.

segments.zh: 下载整本书：选好章节范围，一键导出带封面和插图的 EPUB，或者纯文本 TXT。
segments.en: Download the whole book: pick a chapter range, then export a full EPUB with cover and images, or plain text.

segments.calloutZh: ✕ 退出后网站停在你读到的章节
segments.calloutEn: Exit lands where you left off
segments.zh: 退出时，网站会停在你读到的那一章。安装链接见下方说明，祝阅读愉快！
segments.en: On exit, the site lands right on the chapter you were reading. Install link below — happy reading!
